ipa.financial_contracts.cap_floor.PricingParameters

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cap_floor.PricingParameters.

Syntax

PricingParameters(
    *,
    index_convexity_adjustment_integration_method: IndexConvexityAdjustmentIntegrationMethod | None = None,
    index_convexity_adjustment_method: IndexConvexityAdjustmentMethod | None = None,
    price_side: PriceSide | str = None,
    market_data_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    market_value_in_deal_ccy: float | None = None,
    report_ccy: str | None = None,
    skip_first_cap_floorlet: bool | None = None,
    valuation_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    implied_volatility_bp: float | None = None,
    implied_volatility_percent: float | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
index_convexity_adjustment_integration_method IndexConvexityAdjustmentIntegrationMethod | None No None
index_convexity_adjustment_method IndexConvexityAdjustmentMethod | None No None
price_side PriceSide | str No None The quoted price side of the instrument. optional. default value is 'mid'.
market_data_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The market data date for pricing. Optional. By default, the marketDataDate date is the ValuationDate or Today
market_value_in_deal_ccy float | None No None MarketValueInDealCcy to override and that will be used as pricing analysis input to compute VolatilityPercent. Optional. No override is applied by default. Note that Premium takes priority over Volatility input.
report_ccy str | None No None Valuation is performed in deal currency. If a report currency is set, valuation is done in that report currency.
skip_first_cap_floorlet bool | None No None Indicates whether to take in consideration the first caplet
valuation_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The valuation date for pricing. Optional. If not set the valuation date is equal to MarketDataDate or Today. For assets that contains a settlementConvention, the default valuation date is equal to the settlementdate of the Asset that is usually the TradeDate+SettlementConvention.
implied_volatility_bp float | None No None User defined implied normal volatility, expressed in basis points.
implied_volatility_percent float | None No None User defined implied lognormal volatility, expressed in percent.
